sources.snippet: Lightweight JIT model is around two megabytes in size. General Silero VAD was trained on huge corpora that include over 6000 languages and it performs well on audios from different domains with various background noise and quality levels. Flexible sampling rate Silero VAD supports 8000 Hz and 16000 Hz sampling rates. Highly Portable
